message.content: It's been getting worse gradually, and my belly feels more swollen and sore all over. I feel sick to my stomach, the nausea is constant. I'm not sure about exact days, though. As for vomiting, stool and gas, I don't have details I can give you on that right now. The only procedure I've had was a scope test (ERCP) about a year ago for gallstones in the bile duct, where they took the stones out and left a small plastic tube (stent) in. I haven't had any other abdominal surgery that I can recall.
